issues.problem_zh: 题面说收敛是“唯一的要求”，但测试还检查字符来源、删除、顺序和依赖到齐后立刻生效。
issues.change_zh: 把“唯一的要求是”改为“要求是”，并补充：text() 的字符都来自已应用的插入；显示的字符只因已应用的删除而消失；应用操作不改变其余字符的先后；依赖的操作都应用后必须立刻生效，之前可以暂缓。英文版同样修改。

checked: read README.zh.md in full and the English prose; topic folder is byte-identical to the original; code blocks identical in both languages
ran the page with tools/run_page.py (both languages pass, 6 blocks)
replayed every statement example of Parts 1-4 literally against the reference (lengths, IndexError cases, undo/redo trace, suggest outputs before and after delete(4, 8))

Parts 1-3: compared TextBuffer with an independent history-cursor model with a hand-written tokenizer and selection-sort ranking over 3000 random sessions (121,263 operations, 32,003 out-of-range calls that must raise and leave everything unchanged, 19,324 undos, 14,621 redos, 17,184 suggest calls including k = -1, k = 0, non-letter and non-ASCII characters, prefixes with spaces/digits), then drained undo and redo completely each time
Part 3: timed suggest on 60k-480k character buffers (12 -> 39 ms, consistent with the stated O(n + m log m))

Part 4: 1500 random 4-replica trials (164,753 operations; half of them with channels reordered arbitrarily, not just lagging; duplicates everywhere) - every local insert landed at the requested index, every local delete removed exactly that character, all replicas converged, the survivors were exactly the inserted-and-never-deleted characters, and 1,466,032 locally observed before/after pairs were never reversed
Part 4: applied a 6-operation history to a fresh replica in all 720 delivery orders - same text every time; replaying all operations again changes nothing
Part 4: with random.seed(0) the statement example converges to 'iH' as the page says (over 2000 seeds: 'iH' 958 times, 'Hi' 1042 times)

Follow-up on collisions: forced two concurrent inserts onto the same fraction - replicas still agree ('xy'), and a later insert between the pair lands at 'Mxy' / 'xMy' / 'xyM' depending on the site id, exactly as the bullet says

code_run.notes: Not acted on (limits of the simple approach, nothing the page claims otherwise): suggest() recurses once per letter, so a single word of about 1000+ letters raises RecursionError; CRDT positions gain 32 bits per sequential insert (2000 appends took 6.8 s here).
